summary: Unit-tested _build_telegram_message (admin_routes.py) by importing it directly. 14 tests, 11 pass. All 4 requested scenarios pass (concurso PMPE_26/CBMPE_26 + cargo, cargo-only Bombeiros, cargo-only Polícia Militar). A custom telegram_titulo still overrides the title, and an empty one does not. Body fields (nome, CPF format, BRT data/hora, device, local, valor R$ 90,00, status emoji) show no regressions. Real stored docs ('PMPE 2026 - Instituto AOCP' / 'CBMPE 2026 - Instituto AOCP') get the right title. 3 edge-case failures: the code does not do what the review request describes, and the real inscricoes doc schema is not fully used.

minor.issue: Gets the title wrong on the fallback concurso text. finalizar.js:21 and confirmacao.html:862 send concurso='PMPE / CBMPE 2026 - Instituto AOCP' when d.__concurso is missing. That string contains 'CBMPE', so PMPE inscriptions get the title 'NOVA INSCRIÇÃO - CBMPE'.

Ignores the 'edital' field ('PMPE_26'/'CBMPE_26'), which is the most reliable indicator. Also ignores 'cargo_titulo', the field where track_registration (admin_routes.py:367) actually stores the cargo. The code reads 'cargo'/'vaga_label', which the inscricoes docs do not have. So a doc with only edital='CBMPE_26' + cargo_titulo='...Bombeiros...' gets the title 'NOVA INSCRIÇÃO - PMPE / CBMPE'.
The fallback does not match the spec. With no concurso and no cargo, the title is 'NOVA INSCRIÇÃO - PMPE / CBMPE', but the review request says it should fall back to 'NOVA INSCRIÇÃO - PMPE'.

action_items: Use insc['edital'] first: CBMPE if 'CBMPE' in edital, else PMPE if edital is 'PMPE_26'.
Next, check cargo_titulo for 'BOMBEIRO' (add it to the cargo_raw sources alongside cargo/vaga_label).
Only then look at the concurso text, treating the combined 'PMPE / CBMPE' string as ambiguous, for example by checking it starts with 'CBMPE'.
Make the final fallback 'PMPE' as the spec says, or update the spec.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_routes.py is over 2100 lines; it should be split into smaller modules.
The old tests in tests/test_telegram_notifications.py still reference 'SEDUC AL 2026' and are out of date.

success_rate.backend: 79% (11/14; all 6 requested items pass, 3 edge cases fail)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_telegram_title_pmpe_cbmpe.py. The 3 failing tests (fallback_concurso_text_with_pmpe_edital, edital_cbmpe_only, no_indicator_fallback) should pass after the fix. settings.main in the DB has no telegram_titulo set, so the dynamic title is what users see in production.
rca of the issue: Detection relies on substring matches in 'concurso' and in 'cargo'/'vaga_label'. The inscricoes docs store 'concurso' (sometimes the combined fallback text), 'edital' and 'cargo_titulo'. Because 'CBMPE' is checked first and the combined text contains it, PMPE inscriptions are misdetected. edital and cargo_titulo are never read.
